source_split: official train for pilot/train/validation; official test for final test
system_prompt: You are a helpful assistant. Solve math problems using concise reasoning. Follow the required plain-text output format exactly. Do not use Markdown formatting or LaTeX.
user_instruction:
Solve the problem below. Use this exact plain-text structure:
Reasoning:
<your concise calculations>
Final answer: <number>

The last line must be Final answer: followed by one decimal number only. Do not put parentheses, units, Markdown, or LaTeX around that number.

Problem:

hidden_index_mapping.7: model.layers[6] raw post-block output BEFORE model.norm
hidden_index_mapping.14: model.layers[13] raw post-block output BEFORE model.norm
hidden_index_mapping.21: model.layers[20] raw post-block output BEFORE model.norm
hidden_index_mapping.28: model.layers[27] raw post-block output BEFORE model.norm

selection_metric: validation AUROC; ties: earlier layer then smaller C
SDPA_backend: math (float32 intermediate attention accumulation with float16 model)
prompt_freeze_reason: Pilot-only format noncompliance; strengthen plain-text formatting and concise reasoning before final pilot/main. Parser and sampled IDs unchanged; no main response observed.

preprocessing.missing_indicators: fixed for every scalar feature; hidden vectors required finite

verification_prompt: Is the proposed response correct? Respond only with CORRECT or INCORRECT.
rebuild_prompt:
Solve this problem afresh. Identify the needed quantities and their relationships, calculate carefully, and give a concise solution. End with Final answer: <number>.

Problem:
review_prompt: Check the proposed solution for reasoning and arithmetic mistakes. Revise only if needed. Give a concise checked solution and end with Final answer: <number>.
verification_system: You are a careful mathematics verifier.
dtype_reason: GTX1080Ti has slow native FP16; FP32 chosen for stable feasible inference. Reused originals were generated FP16 on V100.
original_reuse: Previously saved natural original responses and generation confidence; immutable source path per record.
scoring: last explicit Final answer/#### number; else last numeric boxed answer; else last number. Exact Decimal equality; dollars/commas normalized; percent stays in question units; no rounding tolerance. Strict-format sensitivity retained. Truncated responses without explicit numeric final marker or boxed answer are failures, never score unfinished last intermediate number. Before the untruncated last-number fallback, prefer a numeric complement of a concluding verb (is/are/was/were/equals/need/take/paid/pay/cost/owe) on the last nonempty line.
recalculate: Conservative numeric equality matching own extracted final answer, safe Decimal AST calculator; no reference. Unavailable masked, fixed policy falls back to Keep.
text_features: Train-fit TF-IDF unigram/bigram max_features=1500, min_df=2; question + original response only
hidden_features: Raw post-block output at last response-overlapping token, first pure newline separator token, final verification prompt token; layers 7/14/21/28. Before any verdict token.
selection: A: validation AUROC. B: validation final accuracy then mean per-action log loss. Independent selection before either test evaluation.
verification_tokenization: Explicit segments [chat through response][two newlines][remaining chat instruction]; concatenated token IDs decode exactly to full prompt. Prevents BPE merging separator into final response token. Same IDs for hidden extraction and verdict generation.
hidden_scaling: Train-only StandardScaler per coordinate, hidden block divided by sqrt(1536). Shared scalar and TF-IDF features unchanged.
prior_task_overrides: Current A/B scope supersedes old detection-only instructions
Official test partition reserved, replacing old train-derived test
Numeric scoring with strict-format sensitivity, replacing format-only primary scoring
Environment restored under /tmp/yaicon-ab because previous venv no longer exists
pilot_debug_changes: BPE separator forced into own token segment
Repair max_new_tokens increased 256 to 512; truncated fallback answers rejected
Repairs batched up to 8, one GPU job, original and verification batch size 1
